title: The God of Love's 100-Soulmate Blunder — Part 2

series.summary: At the matchmaking shrine, the God of Love manifests before Rentaro with shocking news: due to a clerical mistake while watching anime, Rentaro is destined to meet one hundred soulmates in high school.

segments.voiceover_text: As Rentaro bows before the shrine altar, a blinding celestial light descends from the sky.
The God of Love manifests in person, declaring that he has arrived to answer Rentaro's prayers.
Consulting the sacred registry of fate, the deity reveals that every normal human is granted only one destined soulmate.
Yet Rentaro's destiny is shattered by an astronomical number: he will meet one hundred destined soulmates during high school.
The panicked god prostrates in apology, confessing he made a clerical error while watching anime—leaving Rentaro terrified of what will happen on his first morning of school.
